difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that Cohen-Macaulayness of a Noetherian local ring is equivalent to Cohen-Macaulayness of its henselization and of its strict henselization. The proof first records that the two henselizations are Noetherian, so that the statement makes sense, and then observes that both the depth and the dimension are unchanged by passing to either henselization. Since Cohen-Macaulayness is the equality of depth and dimension, the three conditions coincide.
